mapper.select: SELECT c.policy_number, c.product_code, c.contract_status, c.payment_cycle, c.premium_amount, COALESCE(c.insured_amount, p.insured_amount) AS insured_amount, COALESCE(c.special_contract_list, p.special_contract_info) AS special_contract_list, COALESCE(c.maturity_refund_amount, p.maturity_refund, 0) AS maturity_refund_amount, c.installment_count, c.has_unpaid_premium, c.contract_start_date, c.contract_end_date, c.insured_name, c.insured_rrn, c.insured_contact, c.account_number, c.account_bank, c.created_at FROM contract c LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_code = c.product_code WHERE c.policy_number = #{policyNumber}
